stories.title: Patient-derived organoids reveal strain-specific efficacy of engineered bacteria in colorectal cancer
stories.authors_source: O’Connor, Erkok, Wright et al.; Communications Medicine (2026-11-18)
stories.takeaway: Patient-derived colorectal tumor organoids show differing colonization and responses to engineered Salmonella versus probiotic E. coli.
stories.what_happened: Patient-derived colorectal tumor organoids show differing colonization and responses to engineered Salmonella versus probiotic E. coli.
stories.method: Patient-derived tumor and matched normal organoid co-culture with two engineered bacterial chassis.
stories.why_it_matters: Human-derived organoids provide a platform to compare microbial therapeutics before clinical testing.
stories.read_first: Compare tumor selectivity and donor-to-donor variation.
stories.caveat: Organoid results do not establish in-vivo safety or clinical efficacy.

stories.title: Gut microbiota GABA regulation by intestinal pH osmolality and microbial consumption
stories.authors_source: Ye, Plüss, Moresi et al.; Nature Communications (2026-11-17)
stories.takeaway: Gut microbial GABA availability depends on physicochemical conditions and microbial production and consumption.
stories.what_happened: Gut microbial GABA availability depends on physicochemical conditions and microbial production and consumption.
stories.method: Microbial culture and gut-environment perturbations assessing GABA metabolism.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows why environmental controls matter when interpreting microbial metabolites.
stories.read_first: Review pH, osmolality and consumption experiments.
stories.caveat: In-vitro ecological regulation may differ from in-vivo host exposure.

stories.title: Macrophage Slfn4 attenuates colonic inflammation and tumorigenesis through Rac1-dependent phagocytosis and oxidative burst
stories.authors_source: Zheng, Guan, Zhao et al.; Communications Medicine (2026-11-17)
stories.takeaway: Slfn4 supports macrophage antibacterial activity and limits experimental colitis and colitis-associated cancer.
stories.what_happened: Slfn4 supports macrophage antibacterial activity and limits experimental colitis and colitis-associated cancer.
stories.method: Slfn4-deficient mouse models, macrophage phagocytosis and oxidative-burst assays.
stories.why_it_matters: Links immune bacterial clearance with intestinal inflammatory outcomes.
stories.read_first: Inspect genetic controls and Rac1 mechanism.
stories.caveat: Mouse and cell findings are not validated therapeutic targets in humans.

stories.title: Designer mucin-responsive nanomedicine for enhanced solid tumour penetration and therapy
stories.authors_source: Yu, Gong, Liu et al.; Nature Biomedical Engineering (2026-11-18)
stories.takeaway: Mucin-triggered micelle disassembly improves delivery into experimental pancreatic tumors.
stories.what_happened: Mucin-triggered micelle disassembly improves delivery into experimental pancreatic tumors.
stories.method: Polymer micelle engineering and mouse pancreatic tumor penetration experiments.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights mucin as a transport barrier and stimulus for drug delivery design.
stories.read_first: Check unimer formation and tissue penetration comparisons.
stories.caveat: Mouse tumor results do not prove clinical efficacy or gastrointestinal delivery.

stories.title: Epigenetics in inflammatory bowel disease: from mechanistic insights to personalized therapeutic strategies
stories.authors_source: Antunes, Noble, Ramsteijn & Satsangi; Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology (2026-11-16)
stories.takeaway: Reviews methylation signatures, exposures and potential IBD treatment-response stratification.
stories.what_happened: Reviews methylation signatures, exposures and potential IBD treatment-response stratification.
stories.method: Synthesis of blood and mucosal epigenetic studies, causal inference and multi-omics.
stories.why_it_matters: Separates systemic biomarkers from tissue-resolved disease biology.
stories.read_first: Read tissue versus blood comparisons and prospective validation discussion.

stories.title: Engineering commensal Lachnospiraceae for programmable therapeutic delivery in the mouse gut
stories.authors_source: Arnold, McClure, Glazier et al.; Nature Microbiology (2026-11-04)
stories.takeaway: Genetic toolkit enables engineered Coprococcus comes to secrete IL-22 in the mouse gut.
stories.what_happened: Genetic toolkit enables engineered Coprococcus comes to secrete IL-22 in the mouse gut.
stories.method: Anaerobe engineering with expression, integration and secretion systems; mouse experiments.
stories.why_it_matters: Expands engineered microbial therapeutics beyond conventional probiotic chassis.
stories.read_first: Inspect secretion stability and in-vivo colonization.
stories.caveat: Mouse proof of concept does not demonstrate human persistence or safety.

stories.title: VapC40 diverts autophagic flux from xenophagy to mitophagy via ammonia-dependent metabolic toxicity
stories.authors_source: Ge, Liu, Wang et al.; Nature Communications (2026-11-18)
stories.takeaway: Mycobacterial toxin-induced ammonia accumulation disrupts macrophage lysosomes and mitochondria, diverting antimicrobial autophagy.
stories.what_happened: Mycobacterial toxin-induced ammonia accumulation disrupts macrophage lysosomes and mitochondria, diverting antimicrobial autophagy.
stories.method: Infected macrophages, metabolic and organelle assays, and bacterial mutant mouse infections.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates pathogen manipulation of host organelle quality control.
stories.read_first: Examine toxin-deficient controls and lysosomal pH measurements.
stories.caveat: Mycobacterial infection model does not directly generalize to gut disease.

stories.title: Nanopore epitranscriptomic profiling of influenza A infection in differentiated primary human airway epithelial cells
stories.authors_source: Islam, Pharo, Knox et al.; Scientific Reports (2026-11-17)
stories.takeaway: Direct RNA sequencing maps RNA modifications and poly(A) dynamics in infected differentiated human airway epithelium.
stories.what_happened: Direct RNA sequencing maps RNA modifications and poly(A) dynamics in infected differentiated human airway epithelium.
stories.method: Air–liquid-interface primary cell cultures and nanopore direct RNA sequencing.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful methodological example of molecular profiling in differentiated human tissue models.
stories.read_first: Inspect modification-calling validation and infection controls.
stories.caveat: Airway virus model is not intestinal physiology; computational modification calls need validation.

stories.title: Recovery of 1,015 metagenome-assembled genomes from Asian elephant fecal metagenomes in China
stories.authors_source: Guo, Zhang, Li et al.; Scientific Data (2026-11-18)
stories.takeaway: A curated elephant gut genome catalog includes 994 bacterial and 21 archaeal MAGs.
stories.what_happened: A curated elephant gut genome catalog includes 994 bacterial and 21 archaeal MAGs.
stories.method: Assembly and quality filtering of metagenomes from 107 elephant fecal samples.
stories.why_it_matters: Expands comparative gut microbiome reference diversity.
stories.read_first: Check completeness, contamination and taxonomic novelty.
stories.caveat: Animal-specific dataset is not directly representative of human microbiomes.

stories.title: Candidalysin: a decade of discovery
stories.authors_source: Richardson, Griffiths, Moyes et al.; Nature Microbiology (2026-11-16)
stories.takeaway: Synthesizes candidalysin roles in fungal infection, mucosal immunity and gut commensalism.
stories.what_happened: Synthesizes candidalysin roles in fungal infection, mucosal immunity and gut commensalism.
stories.method: Review of fungal virulence, host-response and experimental gut-model literature.
stories.why_it_matters: Broadens host-microbiome considerations to fungal factors.
stories.read_first: Read gut commensalism section and experimental model limitations.
stories.caveat: Review does not establish clinical intervention efficacy.
